title: pouteria eluviicola
intro: Pouteria eluviicola, commonly known as the Brazil nut tree, is a species of tree in the family Sapotaceae. This tree is known for its large, edible seeds, which are rich in nutrients and offer various health benefits. The Brazil nut tree has been used in traditional medicine to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin problems due to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in the Brazil nut tree include proteins, lipids, and phytosterols, as well as various minerals and vitamins, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
